title: Spec fixes for every open e2e finding on both platforms, as one bug spec
context: After the 2026-09-27 severity breakdown (2 Blocks, 14 Hurts, 12 Cosmetic open across macOS and Android; nothing merged since d36b748), the owner had to choose what to take on next. This thread tests and reports, and fixing is out of scope for it, so the fix work needed its own vehicle.
options: Spec fixes for every open finding on both platforms in one interphase bug spec
Spec only the Blocks and Hurts
Separate specs per subsystem (accessibility bridge, text input, photos, reminders, settings, cosmetics)
outcome: The owner chose the first: "spec the fixes to each of the above issues on both Android and macOS. Make sure to understand the root cause and all relevant surfaces of the issues above such that the issue is resolved without further regression." The spec is written with the interphase bug pathway at docs/specs/android-macos-e2e-fixes.md and will be dispatched later as separate draft pull requests. Keeping it one spec with Steps grouped to ship separately was the agent's stated default, following the android-e2e-defect-fixes precedent; the owner may still override it.
